reviewer: Implementation agent; not independent expert or human adjudication
reason: Existing human reference concerns safety rather than this primary mortality HR; case previously exposed, not held out.

domains.finding: Reported computer-generated variable blocks and sequential identical pharmacist-prepared packs support sequence and concealment. Baseline differences were retained without treating significance or imbalance alone as randomization failure.
domains.limitation: Pack dispensing and pharmacist separation are reported procedures, not independently audited execution.

domains.finding: Assignment effect uses all817 randomized, retaining untreated/nonadherent participants. Nine revelations do not by themselves establish trial-context deviations; resistance-directed changes and adverse-event interruptions are not automatically such deviations.
domains.limitation: Recipients/timing/consequences of nine revelations are unknown. ProbablyYes for personnel awareness is an inference, not direct recipient documentation. Appropriate ITT analysis does not settle D3.

domains.finding: 53 incomplete follow-ups for reasons other than death and last-known-alive censoring distinguish analysis membership from complete mortality ascertainment. Covariate/disability imputation does not establish mortality robustness. One home-to-die uncontactable participant supports possible health-related missingness.
limitations: Exact censoring times and later vital status of incomplete follow-ups are unknown; counts are not an HR sensitivity calculation.
D3.4 phrase establishes dependence for one participant overstates the source: severe prognosis linked to loss supports possible dependence, not known death or proof of outcome dependence.
High follows submitted PN/N/Y/NI algorithm path. NI does not prove missingness likely depended on actual mortality; empirical bias remains uncertain.

domains.finding: Common monitoring and direct death/date determination support unlikely influence despite possible assessor awareness. Does not require logical impossibility of influence.
domains.limitation: Outside-hospital verification and performed tracing are incompletely described. Planned visits do not establish actual ascertainment; awareness-driven differential contact remains unestablished.

domains.finding: Final SAP2.0 April5,2015 explicitly prior to unblinding matches all-randomized assignment, primary treatment-only Cox stratified HIV/MRC and operational follow-up. It explains logrank-to-Cox change and declares alternatives. Supports qualified ProbablyYes and ProbablyNo without demanding audit timestamps or pretending one eligible analysis.
limitations: Actual investigator/statistician access logs unavailable; independent DSMC access is not equivalent to investigator unblinding.
Conditional PH fallback execution is not fully audited. Operational window includes days274/275 and differs from strict target; model retained broader relation. No forced exact match.

overall: High because D3High; no cumulative SomeConcerns policy needed
causal_claim: Unpaired live example cannot establish arithmetic or guidance improvement caused judgment quality, nor superiority to AllLow.
